content: Between the bars of the cage, the bird has made its nest. Break the bars, O seeker, and take to the open sky.
author: Kabir
explanation: Human beings grow comfortable inside the cages of habitual beliefs, dogmas, and fears. True spirituality requires courage to dismantle conditioned limitations and soar in unbound consciousness.
practicalInsight: Identify one self-limiting belief you cling to for familiar comfort. Challenge it with action today.
reflectionPrompt: What cage bars have I mistaken for safety?
